operations.summary: List tenant balances for manual administration
operations.description: Requires billing.adjustments.manage in a platform scope. Accounts without entries are returned with a zero balance and revision one.

params.name: scope_ids
params.description: Optional comma-separated set of 1–100 distinct canonical, nonzero tenant scope UUIDs. Intersects the existing search and active-tenant filters before pagination. Unknown, platform and inactive scopes produce no rows; omission preserves the unfiltered behavior. Requires the same billing.adjustments.manage permission as the account list. Reading never creates accounts or postings.
